description: Client-side script for date validation and manipulation in web pages, including functions to check date validity, compare dates, and extract date information from form controls.

methods.name: isValidDate
methods.description: Checks if the provided year, month, and day constitute a valid date.

methods.name: newDateFromNumbers
methods.description: Creates a Date object from year, month, and day numbers, adjusting for JavaScript's zero-based month index.

methods.name: isDateBefore
methods.description: Determines if one date occurs before another.

methods.name: isDateSetActive
methods.description: Checks if the date selection controls in a form are active/enabled.

methods.name: isDateEqual
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects represent the same calendar date.

methods.name: newDateFromNamedFields
methods.description: Constructs a Date object from form controls representing a date.

methods.name: getValueFromNamedElement
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an HTML element by its ID.

methods.name: getMonthFromName
methods.description: Returns the numeric month corresponding to a month name string.
